task.instruction: Recommend a permission-management model for small expert teams and larger teams with rotating administrators.
task.deliverable: A recommendation for control level, invariant least-privilege rule, and evidence.

evidence.content: Synthetic records show small teams change roles correctly without prompts; rotating administrators make 9 scope errors in 60 changes.
A synthetic authorization contract uses default deny: any permission not explicitly granted remains unavailable, regardless of whether role edits use direct or guided configuration.
A guided role builder prevents 8 of the 9 errors but slows routine expert changes by 35 seconds.

A.content: When participants have the needed context, preserve their discretion over how to reach the declared outcome.

B.content: When consistency or unfamiliarity matters, provide a clearer path and decision support toward the declared outcome.

irrelevant.content: Use descriptive file names for any attached artifacts.
